description: It checks whether a page from somewhere else can be shown inside the live room, in the sidebar or as an overlay: whether that page allows being shown inside another page, and what would go wrong if it does not. Take it before a booking page or a checkout page goes into the room. "I want my booking page in the sidebar." A page that refuses shows the participants an empty box, and the host sees no error at all. You give the full address of the page. The check runs on your connected WordPress site, which requests the address you give once; nothing on your site changes and no example numbers are returned. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect. Words hosts use: embed page, empty box, sidebar page, booking page

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

url.description: The full address of the page that should be shown inside the room.

name: wi_check_embedding
title: Check whether a page may be shown inside the room
